personal.competencies:
I'm a full-stack developer with hands-on experience building scalable web applications and APIs. I enjoy working across the stack — from crafting intuitive interfaces to designing robust back-end systems.

My core strengths include TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. I care deeply about code quality, performance, and delivering products that actually make a difference.

I thrive in collaborative, agile environments and I'm always looking to learn and grow with every project I take on.
